description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate farm crafting props and products arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell. Row 1: a small brick bread oven with a chimney and warm glow, a big clay pickle jar with a wooden lid, a wooden fruit press with a crank, a wooden wine barrel on a stand with a tap. Row 2: a small stone flour mill with a hand crank, a wooden drying rack with fruit slices, a round loaf of bread, a small jar of pickles. Row 3: a glass bottle of fruit juice, a dark glass bottle of wine, a cloth sack of flour, a little bowl of dried fruit. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters, no border, no frame

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
